fusions.name: Thin Slices
fusions.desc: A carving slice that deals 3 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pick the Bones
fusions.desc: A carving cut that deals 22 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Carver's Share
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more Power for 10 seconds, and you restore 12 health.

fusions.name: Fed and Keen
fusions.desc: When you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
